================================================================================
ranges
================================================================================

message Test { extensions 4, 20 to max; }

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

parseTree = [
  {kind: BOF},
    {kind: message},
    {kind: Identifier},
    {kind: {},
      {kind: extensions},
        {kind: Integer},
          {kind: Integer},
          {kind: max},
        {kind: to, subtreeSize: 3},
      {kind: ,, subtreeSize: 5},
    {kind: ;, subtreeSize: 7},
  {kind: }, subtreeSize: 11},
  {kind: EOF},
]

================================================================================
ranges expected integer
================================================================================

message Test { extensions "nope"; }

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

parseTree = [
  {kind: BOF},
    {kind: message},
    {kind: Identifier},
    {kind: {},
    {kind: extensions},
    {kind: String, hasError: true},
  {kind: }, subtreeSize: 6},
  {kind: EOF},
]
errs = [expected [Integer HexInteger OctInt max], got String]
